worldcombat.skill.coil.summary: Coil briefly, then spring along your aim until a body, wall or ledge stops you. Carry one spring charge for four seconds: your next successful close physical contact gains extra damage.
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.0: Spring closer before a contact attack
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.1: Trade step distance for a stronger contact
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.2: Keep the charge until a contact actually deals damage
worldcombat.skill.coil.description.0: Spring up to %1$s blocks, then multiply the next successful close physical contact by %2$s. The opportunity lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.coil.description.1: Prepare %1$s, recover %2$s, cooldown %3$s. Bodies, walls and unsupported ground stop the step early.
worldcombat.skill.coil.tight.on: Tight coil: ×0.75 step distance, ×1.5 contact damage; four extra preparation ticks and fifteen extra cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.coil.tight.off: Loose coil: full step distance, ×1.25 contact damage, shorter preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.coil.timing: Aim within %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s seconds, pay %4$s PP, recover %3$s seconds, cooldown %5$s seconds from commitment.
Shorten the spring for a stronger contact; preparation and cooldown increase.
worldcombat.skill.coil.preference.ai.max: Prepare only when a short spring can bring the enemy closer.
worldcombat.skill.coil.preference.ai.min: Attack directly when closer, without stopping to prepare.
